package.description: A free software tool that helps optimize the performance of your Crucial SSD.

en-US.description: A free software tool that helps optimize the performance of your Crucial SSD.
en-US.longDescription: Crucial Storage Executive enables your Crucial SSD to become even faster and allows it to get periodic updates so it’s constantly performing at its best. With Storage Executive, you can see how much storage (GB) you’ve used, download the latest firmware, monitor the drive’s temperature, reset your encryption password, and enable the Momentum Cache feature, which makes many SSD operations up to 10x faster.
en-US.name: Crucial Storage Executive

zh-CN.description: 帮助优化 Crucial 英睿达 SSD 性能的免费软件工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: Crucial Storage Executive 可加快 Crucial 英睿达 SSD 的速度，提供定期升级，保持良好运行状态。您可以通过 Storage Executive 查看已使用多少存储空间 (GB)，下载新版固件，监测硬盘温度，重置加密密码，以及启用 Momentum Cache 功能，从而让大部分 SSD 的操作速度加快 10 倍。
zh-CN.name: Crucial Storage Executive
